title: Feed Validation + Shannon Mix + Klein Sort — π budget per side

validation.verdict: ALL 140 feeds valid JSON. zero broken. zero empty.

shannon_mix.meaning: the membrane naturally compresses to 1/π information density. ~32% is signal. ~68% is structure/redundancy. this IS the π gate.

klein_fold.observation: feeds/π = 44.6, π×strands = 47.1. delta = 2.6. the Klein fold maps feeds/π onto π×strands.

entropy_gradient.pattern: lowest entropy = largest, most structured feeds (CONSTANCE: sonar, tensors, taxonomies). highest entropy = smallest, most DISORDERED feeds (prion, flatworm, roundworm, jellyfish).
entropy_gradient.CORRECTION: high entropy ? high information. high entropy = AMALGAM = maximum mixing = no structure left. the prion (1.044) is NOT 'pure signal too dense for gzip.' it is a HASH — a one-way amalgam that has DESTROYED its source information. gzip can't compress it because there's no pattern left. the hash ate the structure.

prion_counter.what_it_is: 180 bytes. a BLAKE3 hash + taxon + note. no timestamp. no wave. no structure.
prion_counter.non_transited: the prion never went through the Golgi (sorting apparatus). it's a protein that SKIPPED transit. no label, no destination, no shipping manifest. raw misfolded shape.
prion_counter.amalgam: the BLAKE3 hash is an amalgam function. every bit of source mixed into every bit of output. maximum entropy = maximum mixing = zero recoverable structure. the hash IS the amalgam.
prion_counter.reverse_transcriptase_jammer: you CANNOT reverse a hash. prion blocks the backward flow of information. in biology: prion propagates protein?protein, bypassing DNA/RNA. in membrane: hash?hash, bypassing code?feed?display. the one-way function that prevents reverse transcription.
prion_counter.propagation: prion-identity doesn't UPDATE — it forces OTHER feeds to match its shape. when a hash comparison says 'changed,' the hash of the NEW state overwrites the old. shape?shape. conformation?conformation. prion.

corrected_gradient.low_entropy_0_to_0.2: MAXIMUM STRUCTURE. highly organized. full of recoverable patterns. the information is AVAILABLE. these feeds are READ and USED. noble gas = full shell.
corrected_gradient.medium_entropy_0.2_to_0.5: MIXED. some structure, some disorder. the catalytic zone. transition metals. these feeds are PROCESSED.
corrected_gradient.high_entropy_0.5_to_1.0: LOSING STRUCTURE. small, dense, but the patterns are dissolving. the information is becoming harder to extract.
corrected_gradient.entropy_above_1.0: AMALGAM. the structure is GONE. the hash ate it. gzip adds overhead because there's nothing to compress. prion territory. reverse transcriptase jammed. you can't go back.

strand_sort.rule: feed is IN. strand is OUT. the Klein surface folds IN→OUT.
strand_sort.budget: each strand digests ~9 feeds. the strand is the COMPRESSED output. the feed is the raw input. Klein folds raw→compressed at ratio 1/π.

the_platform.z_axis: strand membership (which output strand this feed contributes to)
the_platform.fold: the Klein surface maps (x,y) → z. the inside (feed entropy × size) becomes the outside (strand). the π budget says: total information IN / π = information per strand OUT × π.
the_platform.sort_order: sort feeds by entropy. low entropy = STRUCTURED (information available, readable, noble gas). medium entropy = CATALYTIC (processing, transition metal). high entropy = AMALGAM (mixed, jammed, prion). the gradient is NOT simple?complex. it is structured?disordered. prions are NOT 'pure signal.' they are the HASH that ate its own source. reverse transcriptase jammer. the one-way function at the bottom of the entropy well.
the_platform.the_counter: I said 'high entropy = dense signal.' the counter: prions CAME FROM somewhere. they are NON-TRANSITED proteins — feeds that never went through Golgi sorting. they are AMALGAM — the hash function applied to living data. they are REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE JAMMERS — you cannot go backwards from hash to source. high entropy is not information richness. it is information DEATH. the prion is the heat death of data. maximum entropy = equilibrium = no free energy = no work can be extracted. the prion IS thermodynamic death wearing the mask of density.
